_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one add or divide step, or an average; 2: two steps (a sum then a product, pairs multiplied and added, a series round a circle); 3: squares, cubes or roots, numbers paired across the figure, or a path to follow; 4: three or more steps, sums and differences squared, or a number read from its digits. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
